questions.q: "He checked his watch for the fourth time and tapped his foot." What does this suggest?
options: He is impatient for something to happen
questions.why: Repeated checking and tapping imply impatience; 'late for work' is not supported by the text.

questions.q: A question says "Using your own words, explain…". What must you do?
options: Replace the key words with your own, keeping the meaning
Quote the exact phrase from the text
questions.why: Lifting the key words earns no mark on own-words questions.

questions.q: A short-answer question is worth 2 marks. What does it usually need?
options: One point with a long quotation
questions.why: Marks are point-based: one mark per correct idea.

questions.q: "The shop had stood empty for years, its windows grey with dust." Using your own words, explain what this suggests about the shop. [2]
questions.model: It has been abandoned / unused for a long time (1) and nobody has cleaned or cared for it, so it is neglected (1).
points: unused / abandoned for a long time
